# Halfway Anywhere

> > Comprehensive thru-hiking guides, backpacking gear reviews, and trail surveys for long-distance hikers tackling the Pacific Crest Trail, Continental Divide Trail, and international treks.

Created by Tyler 'Mac' Fox, Halfway Anywhere serves as the definitive resource for thru-hikers and ultralight backpackers, featuring annual trail surveys, detailed gear testing, and complete planning guides for major trails including the PCT, CDT, JMT, and Himalayan treks. The site combines data-driven insights from thousands of hikers with hands-on gear reviews to help adventurers prepare for multi-day and long-distance journeys.

## Key Topics

- Pacific Crest Trail (PCT)
- Continental Divide Trail (CDT)
- John Muir Trail (JMT)
- Thru-hiking
- Ultralight backpacking
- Backpacking gear reviews
- Trail surveys and planning data
- Nepal trekking (Three Passes Trek, Everest Base Camp)
- Long-distance hiking
- Camping equipment
- Himalayan trekking
- New Zealand hiking (Milford Track)
- Trail planning and resupply strategies
- Outdoor gear testing
- High-altitude trekking

## Major Trail Resources

- [The Ultimate Continental Divide Trail Resource](https://www.halfwayanywhere.com/continental-divide-trail): Complete CDT thru-hiking resource covering 3,100mi Mexico-to-Canada route
- [Pacific Crest Trail Survey](https://www.halfwayanywhere.com/pacific-crest-trail-survey): Annual PCT thru-hiker survey data on gear, resupply, and strategies
- [The John Muir Trail Hiker Survey](https://www.halfwayanywhere.com/john-muir-trail-survey): Annual JMT hiker survey providing trail planning data and insights

## Backpacking Gear Reviews

- [The Ultimate Backpacking Gear Resource](https://www.halfwayanywhere.com/backpacking-gear): Central hub for backpacking gear reviews, lists, and ultralight resources
- [Best Shoes for Thru-Hiking in 2026](https://www.halfwayanywhere.com/backpacking-gear/best-thru-hiking-shoes): Trail runner & hiking shoe reviews for PCT, CDT, JMT thru-hiking
- [Best Camping Sleeping Pads for 2026](https://www.halfwayanywhere.com/backpacking-gear/best-camping-sleeping-pads): Sleeping pad reviews featuring Therm-a-Rest NeoAir & Sea to Summit models
- [The Best Backpacking Quilts for 2026](https://www.halfwayanywhere.com/backpacking-gear/best-backpacking-quilts): Katabatic Flex & Enlightened Equipment quilt reviews for thru-hiking
- [Best Satellite Messengers & PLBs for Thru-Hiking for 2026](https://www.halfwayanywhere.com/backpacking-gear/best-satellite-messengers): Garmin inReach, ACR ResQLink PLB reviews for backcountry safety
- [Best Socks for Thru-Hiking in 2026](https://www.halfwayanywhere.com/backpacking-gear/best-thru-hiking-socks): Darn Tough & merino wool sock reviews for long-distance hiking
- [Best Ultralight Freestanding 1-Person Tents](https://www.halfwayanywhere.com/home/best-ultralight-freestanding-1-person-tents): Solo tent comparison guide featuring SlingFin Portal 1 and alternatives
- [Best Merino Wool T-Shirts of 2026](https://www.halfwayanywhere.com/best-merino-wool-t-shirts): Ridge Merino, Patagonia, Icebreaker tee comparison for outdoor activities

## Himalayan Trekking Guides

- [Three Passes Trek](https://www.halfwayanywhere.com/three-passes-trek): Complete trekking guide for Nepal's Three Passes Trek in Everest Region
- [Everest Base Camp](https://www.halfwayanywhere.com/everest-base-camp): Comprehensive EBC trek planning guide for Nepal's Himalayan journey

## International Hiking Guides

- [New Zealand Trekking and Hiking Guides](https://www.halfwayanywhere.com/new-zealand-trekking): NZ hiking guides covering Milford Track, Ball Pass, and mountain huts
- [Tasmania Trekking: Hiking Guides for Tasmania](https://www.halfwayanywhere.com/tasmania-trekking): Australia's Tasmania hiking trail directory and multi-day trek guides
- [Bicycling the Outback](https://www.halfwayanywhere.com/australia-bike-tour): Melbourne-to-Darwin bikepacking guide across Australian Outback
